**Day 1 · Module 3 · fills Sheet 3**

> *Which standards do we adopt rather than author — and who owns the national core data set?*

### On the canvas: Sheet 3 · Core data set, terminology and specifications

<img src="country-canvas/page-4.png" alt="Country Canvas Sheet 3: Core data set, terminology and specifications" style="width:100%;max-width:900px;border:1px solid #ccc"/>

| Part | Time | What the table does |
|---|---|---|
| **Data elements** | 20 min | 15 immunization DAK elements, each captured Same, Differently or Not at all. |
| **Our terminology and specifications** | 5 min | SNOMED CT, ICD, LOINC, the terminology service, the core data set, the national FHIR IG, the IPS and the SMART immunization DAK. |
| **Who owns it, and what we buy** | 5 min | Who would own the core data set and run the terminology service; what goes into the next procurement. |
{: .grid }

### Where it meets the journey

| Step | What the system does | Policy question for the table |
|---|---|---|
| ● [J2a](en/smart-trust-demo/journeys/smart-trust-demo/workshops/dpi-h-policy-track/walkthrough/J2a/) A health worker finds the baby — and reads his cards | A core data element that tells a reported dose from a verified one. | Who in your country defines the data element that tells a reported dose from a verified one? |
| ● [J3b](en/smart-trust-demo/journeys/smart-trust-demo/workshops/dpi-h-policy-track/walkthrough/J3b/) Taifafeki vaccines are fitted to the Onesan schedule | Terminology service: Taifafeki's product code kept, Onesa's schedule code added beside it; schedule logic over every dose. | Who owns your national core data set and the code maps to other countries, and is vaccine code licensing settled? |
{: .grid }

Also draws on: ○ [J1](en/smart-trust-demo/journeys/smart-trust-demo/workshops/dpi-h-policy-track/walkthrough/J1/) (Will you adopt the immunization core data set, or design your own national form?); ○ [J4.0b](en/smart-trust-demo/journeys/smart-trust-demo/workshops/dpi-h-policy-track/walkthrough/J4.0b/) (Will you adopt the IPS and the VHL specification as they are, and author only national extensions?).

### Questions for the table

- Does your national core data set tell a dose the family reported from one that was verified? Who defines that element? ([J2a](en/smart-trust-demo/journeys/smart-trust-demo/workshops/dpi-h-policy-track/walkthrough/J2a/))
- Who owns the national core data set and the mapping between other countries’ vaccine codes and yours? ([J3b](en/smart-trust-demo/journeys/smart-trust-demo/workshops/dpi-h-policy-track/walkthrough/J3b/))
- Which code systems do you use for vaccine products, and is the licence question settled? ([J3b](en/smart-trust-demo/journeys/smart-trust-demo/workshops/dpi-h-policy-track/walkthrough/J3b/))
